review_kind: Manual source reasoning only; not a second review/repair cycle or native acceptance

invariants.source: validatePlanProjection compares selected physical/ledger pages, independently read scope ledger, all manifests and descriptor IDs; all three raw row lists must have identical owned relative order. Original/working plan owned rows must exactly match their separate lists. compose checks the same order and uses only existing object spans.
invariants.implication: The observed214 existing pages can be replaced; no unknown/missing/duplicated/reordered/add/delete page scope is accepted.

invariants.source: planDocument recursively scans strings with escapes, nested objects/arrays, numbers and literals; JSON.parse validates string tokens, duplicate object keys are rejected by decoded key identity, every full plan page has a unique ID. It retains original source offsets and raw page-object strings.
invariants.implication: Quotes/braces inside strings or nested structures do not delimit page records accidentally; replacing exact object spans retains foreign raw separators/top-level bytes.

invariants.source: Preflight and locked transaction call composePlanProjection separately with head/index bases. Each call reverses replacement spans to reconstruct its exact original base and compares foreign raw residual plus target owned rows. Separate composed blobs populate HEAD and integrated index.
invariants.implication: Foreign working rows are never copied into either blob. Every foreign page/order/top-level byte is retained from its own actual Git base; an independently staged foreign plan remains separately staged.

invariants.property: Worktree preservation and atomic native boundary
invariants.source: Plan path is excluded from ordinary working-file hash-object selection and replaced by composed object blobs. Existing transaction never writes plan-spec, compares current fileState at the native ref boundary and after commit, retains index lock, original-index-byte equality, outside metadata checks and main compare-and-swap.
invariants.implication: All foreign working bytes remain present; concurrent incompatible current inputs fail closed. The normal actual validated frontier/context assertion and report/commit order remain.

invariants.source: loadScope validates one separate typed descriptor, original immutable Git objects, current scope/manifest/home target and evidence hashes. Readiness adds descriptor/evidence while retaining its broader scientific projection. Context seal includes the descriptor binding. Native preflight, commit scope re-read and successful receipt retain exact projection authority.
invariants.implication: No historical acceptance or original receipt is rewritten; changing target/scope/evidence invalidates preparation. Transitive suppliers remain science context without commit ownership.

invariants.source: step6-ledger-fragment.mjs is not edited; its allowed path/addition-only semantics remain. plan_projection is a separate policy member accepted only for mathematics v3.
invariants.implication: The ledger fragment API is not widened into plan replacements; physics/legacy do not acquire new projection permission.

invariants.source: The explicit-policy mixed-plan branch in selectSharedOwnership compares foreign raw residuals using scope.pages only and rejects a relevant mixed plan without authority; existing foreign-only unchanged-projection behavior remains.
invariants.implication: The current dangerous whole-working-plan blob cannot be committed via v3 when foreign bytes differ and plan authority is absent.

limits: No runtime execution, syntax checker, tests, hashes, native preflight or gate was run for this proposal. Root must review complete source successors and exact preimage guards before installation.
This implementation intentionally admits replacements only for existing owned pages with unchanged relative order. It is not a generic plan add/remove/reorder system.
Observed target plan snapshot is context only; nativeu1 may still update it. Actual target authority must be minted from a stable late source after drain.
The new parser reads complete shared plan bytes to select spans, but it does not claim ownership of unrelated rows or scan/hash unrelated library bodies.
